title: My current CV
text:
In my research, I am interested in how careless responding can be modeled and addressed in intensive longitudinal data. More broadly, I am interested in questions of measurement and how methodological approaches can improve data quality.
I started my PhD in October 2024 as an associated member of the Research Training Group Statistical Modeling in Psychology (SMiP) under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Tanja Lischetzke.

title: Malin Müller
text:
Malin Müller
I am a PhD candidate at the RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau and an associated member of the Research Training Group Statistical Modeling in Psychology (SMiP). I am interested in improving measurement in intensive longitudinal data (e.g., careless responding, response styles, and measurement reactivity). In my PhD, I investigate how careless responding can be detected and addressed in experience sampling studies using different mixture modeling approaches.
